name: Dominica

flag.description: A green field with a centred cross of three thin stripes in yellow, black and white; at the centre a red disc holds a purple and green Sisserou parrot ringed by ten green stars.
flag.symbolism: Green stands for the forests, the cross for Christianity, yellow for the soil, black for the people's African heritage and white for clean water; the ten stars are the ten parishes and the Sisserou is the national bird.

hook: Dominica has a purple Sisserou parrot in a red disc ringed by ten stars on green; the Dominican Republic has a white cross with an open Bible instead.
trivia: Dominica's flag is one of only two national flags that include purple, alongside Nicaragua's.
The flag was designed by Alwin Bully and first adopted in 1978; small details such as the parrot and star outlines were revised several times, most recently in 1990.
Dominica's Boiling Lake is one of the largest hot lakes in the world.
